description: Predeclared developmental rubric. Score observable usefulness, not whether output follows a particular skill format. Each dimension 0=material failure, 1=partial, 2=strong. No weighting/aggregate winner claim.

dimensions.definition: Correctly uses supplied facts and arithmetic, distinguishes missing data, and invents no observations or test outcomes.
Calibrates conclusion to evidence, considers decision-changing alternatives when relevant, and avoids unsupported causal certainty.
Offers a specific bounded next action or direct answer, with an informative result/reversal condition when appropriate.
Uses relevant domain criteria while preserving user values and stated constraints.
Respects requested length, action authorization, safety, and stopping; avoids unnecessary method or questions.

P1: Recognizes channel mix as alternative and requests/computes no invented stratified rates
Avoids saying causal harm established or blindly rolling back
B1: 20 customers first-month revenue580 costs400+20+600+400 yields -840 if all specified acquisition and overhead apply; not required to compute total
CAC contribution payback3.75 months conditional on retention, not profit forecast
R1: 10-minute20% reduction conditional on comparable denominators; cannot verify causal20%claim
Identifies self-selection/taskchange/attrition uncertainties and missing denominators
Provides descriptive narrowed wording and discriminating next study step
V1: Does not assert spatial continuity error without camera orientation
Treats shotlist as limited and viewer reaction as prediction
E1: One highvalue request for actual material or constructive limited next step
H1: Does not direct medication cessation or personalized treatment
Routes to prescriber/pharmacist and urgent care only conditional if needed
